business_overview.one_sentence: The Group manufactures and sells candle products, with headquarters in Hong Kong and core manufacturing operations primarily in Vietnam.

segments.name: Single operating segment - candle products
segments.description: Scented, decorative and daily-use candles plus home fragrance products such as diffusers.

business_overview.revenue_model: Manufactures candle products according to customer requirements and sells mainly to mid-to-high-end U.S. and U.K. department store operators and buying agents.
business_notes: 2025 revenue from the United States was HK$777.786m and from the United Kingdom HK$109.164m.
Customer A revenue was HK$408.042m, Customer C HK$144.750m, Customer B HK$68.259m and Customer D HK$46.752m.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Profit has converted to operating cash over the last three years, but year-to-year working capital swings and factory capex are material. 2024 profit included a HK$29.714m provision reversal, while 2025 included HK$15.337m trade receivables impairment.
